summary: Set the Latin and complex-script fonts to Arial on every run that carries its own font, on every style that defines a font, and in the document defaults — body, headers, footers, footnotes and endnotes. Symbol/dingbat fonts, the East Asian font slot and font sizes are left alone.
assumptions: Symbol/Wingdings runs and styles (bullets, special characters) are left alone — changing them would change the glyphs
list numbers and bullets drawn from numbering definitions keep their own fonts
runs inside pending tracked insertions/deletions get the new font too
whole-document formatting is applied plain, not as tracked formatting changes (decision §14.1)
